title: Business Central 29.0 Is GA: New Environment

chapters.title: Environment Creation Overview and Sandbox/Production Setup
Creating New Environments with Localization and Version Selection
Version 28 Environment Planning and Deprecation Timeline

features.name: Version 29.0 General Availability
features.description: Microsoft announced general availability for Business Central version 29.0 (2026 release wave 2). New cloud customers will begin onboarding with version 29.0 starting today.
features.status_evidence_quote: today Microsoft announced general availability for version 29.0
caveats: On-premises version discussed separately in following video

features.name: Environment Creation Wizard
features.description: Admin center provides a wizard to create new sandbox or production environments with configurable localization and version selection.
caveats: Version 28 and preview options still available but will be removed

features.name: Localization Selection in Environment Setup
features.description: During environment creation, administrators select the country where the customer does business to ensure appropriate local regional extensions are available in the Kronos environment.

features.name: Version 28 Deprecation
features.description: Version 28 and preview options will eventually be removed from the environment creation interface. Customers should create version 28 environments now if they have planned go-lives with version 28.
features.status_evidence_quote: sooner than later, 28 will go away and uh in sometime the preview will also go away
caveats: Affects upgrade planning for existing customers

features.name: Environment Copy Capability
features.description: Admin center allows copying sandbox environments to production, production to sandbox, or sandbox to sandbox with no limitations.

features.name: Notification Recipients for Compatibility Alerts
features.description: Administrators can set notification recipients in admin center to receive email alerts from Microsoft when extensions may not be compatible with version 29.

features.name: Upgrade Schedule Postponement
features.description: Administrators can delay automatic upgrades to version 29 in production environments to allow customer testing and prevent surprise updates during business hours.
caveats: Different schedules recommended for production vs sandbox

features.name: Update Window Configuration
features.description: Administrators can set a time window for upgrades based on customer time zone and working hours. Minimum window is 6 hours and represents maximum time before rollback may occur.
caveats: 6 hours is maximum time before potential rollback, not expected upgrade duration

features.name: Early Sandbox Upgrade for Testing
features.description: Administrators should upgrade sandbox environments to version 29 as early as possible to allow users to test new features before scheduling production upgrades.
caveats: Approximately one month validation period mentioned

quotes.text: today Microsoft announced general availability for version 29.0 or you can call it 2026 release wave 2
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms official GA status and naming convention for version 29.0

quotes.text: starting today any new customers who onboards to cloud will be starting with version 29
quotes.why_it_matters: All new cloud customers now default to version 29.0

quotes.text: By default with every business central tenant you get one production and three sandboxes. You can always purchase additional production environment if needed
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes baseline licensing model for cloud environments

quotes.text: if you're planning a customer go live in the following month where they have done testing on version 28 this is the right time
quotes.why_it_matters: Urgent guidance for customers in mid-implementation with version 28

quotes.text: You cannot go less than 6 hour because it need to be 6 hour. It doesn't mean that the upgrade will take 6 hours.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that 6-hour minimum is not upgrade duration but maximum time before rollback

quotes.text: If you have PTEES, this is the time when you can create these environment or review your PTE with the newer version 29 symbol
quotes.why_it_matters: Calls partners to validate extensions during GA launch window

this is the right time to kind of create and hold an environment on 28 because as these options will ...
